name: TradeCore ERP
description: v1.0.9 build 2026-09-08-20 DIRECT MYSQL CRUD PERSISTENCE FOR ALL MASTER ENTITIES: Companies already committed straight into MySQL; Branches/Stores/Categories/Users only reached MySQL through the debounced save_state blob flush, so a record created on one device could be missing on another until the next flush and DELETED users reappeared after refresh (no SQL delete). Fixes: (1) canonical v2 endpoint aliases on the PHP side — v2_upsert_user / v2_list_users / v2_delete_user (delegate to the user_accounts handlers, which upsert BOTH user_accounts AND the legacy tradecore_users mirror in one request, so a created account is authable on any device immediately) and v2_upsert_branch / v2_delete_branch (delegate to the stores handlers — branches ARE store rows whose branch_id equals their own id) — every master entity now has direct, company-scoped INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE endpoints; (2) frontend DIRECT-MySQL wiring — 'users' and 'categories' joined DIRECT_SYNC_KEYS and are committed one-record-at-a-time via v2_upsert_user_account / v2_delete_user_account (per-record scope + prev-map delete lookup) and, for categories (stored in state as company-scoped STRING keys 'co_<companyId>:<name>' rather than id-objects), a string-wise diff that posts v2_upsert_category / v2_delete_category per added/removed name; (3) boot-time reconciliation — initPhpSync now fetches the per-company snapshot AND the parallel v2 MySQL reads (companies / branches / stores / categories / users) simultaneously and hydrates local state, so a record a second device wrote straight into MySQL appears on THIS device at boot, no blob-delta polling required (branches/stores are partitioned from the stores table exactly like the server's v2_list_branches view); (4) auto-logout / resurrection prevention — new and edited users created via ManageUsers and via public registration are AWAITED through apiUpsertUser before the form/screen closes so the row exists in MySQL the instant creation finishes (their first login can never hit 'session not found in server snapshot'), category deletes execute the SQL v2_delete_category FIRST and purge local state only on success (MasterData), deleted users cannot resurrect (v2_delete_user_account soft-deletes both user_accounts and tradecore_users, and every v2 read filters deleted_at), and the session scope-guard gained a fresh-account exemption — a firstLogin (or sub-20-minute-old) account is never treated as 'terminated by system administration' even when a lagging snapshot does not list it yet.
